bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Anzen has one Ethereum native USDz liability source and four reviewed representations: a Base LayerZero OFT plus Arbitrum, Blast, and Manta ChildUSDzV2 burn-and-mint contracts. The Base OFT and child LayerZero adapters are independently authored as bridge-mint/bridge-burn holders; their owner Safes control peers, pause, delegates, and mint-role administration. Child maxSupply() is zero, so token-level bridge minting is uncapped even though the route is intended to conserve supply through outbound burn and inbound mint.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex USDz canonicality and bridge-risk verification

protocols.name: Anzen USDz contract registry
protocols.note: The official registry lists USDz on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Blast, and Manta, and separately identifies the Arbitrum, Blast, and Manta USDz OFT adapters.

routes.reviewNote: Ethereum is the only independently issued USDz liability source. At block 25771000 on 2026-08-17, the verified non-proxy USDz source had SPCT-backed deposit() and depositBySPCT() paths calling _mintUSDz and incrementing totalPooledSPCT; owner() was the Anzen 2-of-6 Safe and endpoint() was LayerZero V2. The pre-mission bridge-representation classification was wrong because these SPCT/collateral deposit mechanics create the native liability; the endpoint is a separate transfer rail.

At Base block 50067288 on 2026-08-17, the verified ChildUSDz source was explicitly for bridging and exposed OFT debit/credit plus owner-controlled pause/configuration, not an SPCT deposit path. endpoint() was LayerZero V2 and peers(30101) pointed to Ethereum USDz; the Ethereum peer(30184) pointed back to this Base token at Ethereum block 25771000. Debit burns the representation and credit mints it, so this is a bridge representation rather than independent native issuance.

At Arbitrum block 495300287 on 2026-08-17, verified ChildUSDzV2/OpStackBurnMintERC677 source identified this contract as a bridge representation with immutable remoteToken() equal to Ethereum USDz. getMinters() returned only adapter 0xdd216101d84d513a12cb7bfb109f7abcf330d58e, and it was both isMinter and isBurner. The adapter burns on debit and calls privileged mint on credit; it is not an independent SPCT-backed issuer.

At Blast block 39057071 on 2026-08-17, verified ChildUSDzV2/OpStackBurnMintERC677 source identified this contract as a bridge representation with immutable remoteToken() equal to Ethereum USDz. getMinters() returned only adapter 0x5a1b8c0e9fe27b9db4913df6b361dea5e96ea129, and it was both minter and burner. The adapter burns on debit and calls privileged mint on credit; it is not an independent native issuer.

At Manta block 9270007 on 2026-08-17, verified ChildUSDzV2/OpStackBurnMintERC677 source identified this contract as a bridge representation with immutable remoteToken() equal to Ethereum USDz. getMinters() returned only adapter 0x04d5ddf5f3a8939889f11e97f8c4bb48317f1938, and it was both minter and burner. The adapter burns on debit and calls privileged mint on credit; it is not an independent native issuer.

controls.label: Anzen Base OFT owner Safe

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Base block 50067288, peers(30101) pointed to the Ethereum USDz address; owner-only setPeer(uint32,bytes32) can replace the trusted LayerZero peer.
routeChecks.caps: No owner-independent per-peer issuance cap was identified in the verified ChildUSDz source.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The verified Base source gates pause, delegate, enforced options, inspector, pre-crime, and peer configuration through this owner Safe.

controls.evidence: At Base block 50067288, the 2-of-7 Safe controlled the ChildUSDz owner-only bridge configuration. This control is bridge administration only; the Base OFT representation's actual bridge mint/burn capability is authored separately in usdz-base-oft-mint-burn.

controls.label: Anzen Base OFT representation mint/burn contract

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The Base ChildUSDz OFT debits by burning the representation and credits by minting it; the route is not an independent SPCT-backed issuance path.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: LayerZero peers bind Base to Ethereum USDz, subject to the Base owner Safe's peer-config capability.
routeChecks.caps: No independent aggregate or per-call representation cap was evidenced; route-level conservation depends on the paired burn-and-mint messaging path.

controls.capDescription: The OFT contract can mint the Base representation on LayerZero credit without a native collateral cap; route-level supply is intended to be conserved by paired debit/burn and credit/mint accounting.
controls.evidence: The verified Base ChildUSDz source is an OFT representation for bridging and exposes the debit/credit burn-and-mint rail. It has no SPCT deposit path; its bridge mint is therefore retained as Bridge Risk rather than compiled into native Mint Authority.

controls.label: Anzen Arbitrum ChildUSDzV2 owner Safe

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The owner-controlled LayerZero adapter can change peer/delegate configuration for the Arbitrum representation.
routeChecks.caps: ChildUSDzV2 maxSupply() returned zero; the owner can grant or revoke the role used by the adapter, with no owner-independent numeric cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Arbitrum block 495300287, owner() was this 2-of-6 Safe and the verified ChildUSDzV2 source made grantMintRole and revokeMintRole owner-only.

controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 495300287, this Safe administered the bridge representation and could replace its sole adapter minter role. That role-administration power remains Bridge Risk; it is not native issuance authority.

controls.label: Anzen Arbitrum LayerZero USDz adapter

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The LayerZero adapter burns the ChildUSDzV2 representation on debit and invokes privileged mint on credit; inbound mint is intended to correspond to outbound burn rather than create an independent native liability.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At the observed block the adapter was the sole active minter and burner; its owner-controlled LayerZero peer/delegate surface is administered by the Arbitrum Safe.
routeChecks.caps: ChildUSDzV2 maxSupply() returned zero, so the active adapter can call mint(address,uint256) without a numeric token cap.

controls.capDescription: The adapter is the sole observed minter and burner; ChildUSDzV2 maxSupply() is zero, so token-level bridge minting is uncapped while the role is active even though the route is burn-and-mint.
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 495300287, getMinters() returned only 0xdd216101d84d513a12cb7bfb109f7abcf330d58e, and isMinter(adapter) and isBurner(adapter) were true. This is the actual representation bridge-mint holder and is authored separately from the owner Safe's admin capability.
